supplemental.scope: Legacy 8781091d92 comparison: RIPv1 retains unfinished ANSI prefixes across SOH/STX commands, resumes after EBC suppression, releases bogus introducers in order and records all raw history. Native independent expectations cover every split/bytewise feed, repeated interruptions, argument ESC, resumed autosense, overflow, callback expansion and RIPv3 escape priority. Nine coherent application cases per encoding check replies, cells/colours, cursor, graphics and completion/history recovery. Closes modern S2/S4 and the mid-ANSI SOH/STX difference; other audit findings remain open. Historical captures unchanged.

supplemental.test: docs/RIP154_CONFORMANCE.md command-parser comparison and docs/RIP154_PARSER.adoc 62-command argument ledger; existing cterm_rip_* and syncterm_rip154_* regressions
supplemental.scope: 2026-11-14 assessment is NOT a full compliance claim. Modern/legacy headless probes and RIPTERM binary checks identify P1-P3 modern regressions and S1-S7 inherited differences, plus documented one-way disable and contradictory research summaries. The argument ledger records signed/unsigned checks, byte/word conversions, errors, unsafe reference accesses and corrections to older Bezier/image/copy-region explanations; it is documentation evidence, not passing runtime coverage of those findings. Open differences are recorded separately from passing regression coverage. CP437/UTF-8 captures use literal expectations; historical reference pixels and provenance are unchanged.

Issue #2 and legacy v1.10b fix 8642e3451be5b872042daf88fce0cf366d737dcc: repeated reset and all five text fonts retain keyboard, button and mouse-region host output and automatic replies. Native literal vectors check plain/bogus mid-line introducers, compatible first-column fallbacks at every packet split and bytewise, and intact XYZ text after split bang/SOH/STX. Modern in-place geometry and synchronous passthrough need no production fix. Historical references unchanged.

supplemental.test: cterm_rip_raster / syncterm_rip154_wire_CP437/UTF-8 / all historical capture groups
supplemental.scope: Locked in-place primitives, XOR's unscaled read/mapped write ordering, offset viewport clipping and larger raster stride, distinct indexed/RGB phases and RGB-preserving inversion. All 256 indexed source/destination combinations for Boolean paste, duplicate palette RGB values and RGB fallback. Explicit supplied/missing alternate-plane publication contracts; v1.10a d2ef8842b2 drops pixelsb before flood publication, synchronizing the full viewport in both phases. Independent live pixel/palette/geometry expectations cover clipped bars/XOR, clipboard modes, flood interior/border and bottom raster padding. All historical non-blinking scenes compare both phases against unchanged original references and UI exclusions.

Shared optional RGB pixel strips preserve both blink planes through live/ring/disconnected history, palette changes and Surface composition; ANSI CP437/UTF-8, RIP v1/v3 with RIP_PIXEL, SkyPix native font text, status on/off. Literal fixture expectations; native clear/draw/status checks preserve both pixel planes after an identical-cell clear. Historical reference captures unchanged.

Literal host-response expectations for template chains and checkbox/radio group state, local playback variables and nested query ordering, popup hotkeys/mouse/cancel/required selection and Unicode labels. Popup dismissal compares a coherent restored pixel plane and palette. Native checks cover bounds, reset, saved fields and error recovery. Historical reference captures unchanged.
